welcome.headline: Get seen by the people who scout talent.
welcome.body: Show your best work. Agents and scouts across Nigeria search here for athletes, musicians, models, actors and creators.

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.subtitle: You need to be 18 or older to join.
signUp.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A short phrase is easy to remember.
signUp.dateOfBirthHint: Only used to confirm your age. Never shown on your profile.
signUp.terms: I agree to the Terms and the Community Guidelines.
signUp.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in

verifyEmail.title: Check your email
verifyEmail.body: We sent a 6-digit code to {email}. It expires in 10 minutes.
verifyEmail.resent: New code sent. Check your inbox and spam folder.

chooseRole.title: How will you use Raising Talents?
chooseRole.body: This decides what your profile looks like. You can change it until you finish setting up.
chooseRole.talentBody: Build a portfolio of your work so agents and scouts can find you.
chooseRole.agentTitle: I am an agent or scout
chooseRole.agentBody: Search for talent and get in touch. Agents are verified before they can message anyone.

home.bodyTalent: Next you will add your discipline, a photo and your first clips.
home.bodyAgent: Next you will confirm your agency details and get verified.

restore.offlineBody: Raising Talents needs a connection to load your account. It will try again when you are back online.

validation.dateInvalid: Enter your date of birth as DD/MM/YYYY.
validation.termsRequired: Tick the box to accept the Terms and Community Guidelines.
validation.codeInvalid: Enter the 6-digit code from the email.

errors.NETWORK: No connection. Check your data or Wi-Fi and try again.
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have access to this.
errors.NOT_FOUND: We could not find that. It may have been removed.
errors.CONFLICT: This changed while you were editing. Refresh and try again.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some details need fixing. Check the highlighted fields.
errors.EMAIL_ALREADY_REGISTERED: An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead.
errors.UNDER_MINIMUM_AGE: You need to be 18 or older to join Raising Talents.
errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: That email and password do not match.
errors.ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED: This account is suspended. Check your email for details.
errors.ACCOUNT_BANNED: This account has been closed for breaking the Community Guidelines.
errors.SESSION_EXPIRED: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.SESSION_REVOKED: You were signed out to keep your account safe. Sign in again.
errors.VERIFICATION_CODE_INVALID: That code is not right. Check the email and try again.
errors.VERIFICATION_CODE_EXPIRED: That code has expired. Send a new one.
errors.VERIFICATION_ATTEMPTS_EXCEEDED: Too many wrong codes. Send a new one.
errors.VERIFICATION_RESEND_TOO_SOON: Wait a moment before asking for another code.
errors.ROLE_ALREADY_LOCKED: Your role is set. Contact support to change it.
errors.PRECONDITION_REQUIRED: Reload your profile, then try saving again.
errors.PRECONDITION_FAILED: Your profile was changed on another device. We have loaded the latest version; check it and save again.
errors.WRONG_ROLE: This part of the app is for a different kind of account.
errors.HANDLE_TAKEN: That username is taken. Try another.
errors.HANDLE_INVALID: That username is not available. Try another.
errors.UNKNOWN_TAXONOMY: One of your choices is no longer available. Pick again from the list.
errors.MEDIA_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED: Use a photo (JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC) or, for your portfolio, a video (MP4 or MOV).
errors.MEDIA_TOO_LARGE: That file is too large. Photos can be up to 15 MB and videos up to 300 MB.
errors.MEDIA_NOT_UPLOADED: The upload did not finish. Check your connection and try again.
errors.MEDIA_UPLOAD_MISMATCH: Something went wrong with that upload. Choose the photo again.
errors.MEDIA_WRONG_STATE: This photo is already being processed.
errors.MEDIA_WRONG_PURPOSE: That photo was uploaded for something else. Choose it again from your gallery.
errors.MEDIA_ALREADY_USED: That photo is already in your portfolio.
errors.PORTFOLIO_FULL: Your portfolio is full. Remove an item to add a new one.
errors.PORTFOLIO_ORDER_MISMATCH: Your portfolio changed on another device. We have loaded the latest order; try again.

crash.title: Something went wrong
crash.body: The app hit a problem it could not recover from. Your account and your work are safe.

pwa.updateReady: A new version of Raising Talents is ready.
pwa.offlineReady: Raising Talents now opens even without a connection.
pwa.installBody: Add Raising Talents to your home screen to open it like any other app.
pwa.installIos: To install, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
pwa.offline: You are offline. Changes will not save until you reconnect.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The link may be old, or the page has moved.

titles.chooseRole: Choose how you will use Raising Talents
